import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time columns to datetime
coffee_sales['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'] + ' ' + coffee_sales['time'])

# Create a new column to indicate total sales per product
product_sales = coffee_sales.groupby('product')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create the bar plot for total sales by product
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
bar_plot = sns.barplot(data=product_sales, x='product', y='total', palette='viridis')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Total Sales by Product in the Coffee Shop', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Product', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product', loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time columns to datetime
coffee_sales['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'] + ' ' + coffee_sales['time'])

# Create a new column to indicate total sales per product
product_sales = coffee_sales.groupby('product')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create the bar plot for total sales by product
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
bar_plot = sns.barplot(data=product_sales, x='product', y='total', palette='viridis')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Total Sales by Product in the Coffee Shop', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Product', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product', loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
